release.body:
## What's Changed
* ci: fix openssh-master integration by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3561
* Skip AEAD ConcurrentStability under Intel SDE; add deterministic context-immutability test by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3562
* Zeroize ChaCha20-Poly1305 key material by @nhatnghiho in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3552
* Record job settings for failed integrations by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3569
* Restricting CI permissions so fork-PR code doesn't run CI with ECR push and shared S3 write permissions by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3546
* Fix BIO socket error handling by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3459
* Reject [UNIVERSAL 0] elements with content as end-of-contents by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3560
* Add OpenSSL-compatible rehash -compat support by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3563
* Harden a number of code-paths to avoid e.g. hangs and invalid input by @torben-hansen in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3543
* Guard against NULL attribute type names in X509_NAME_print_ex by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3574
* Fail openssl ca when the issued certificate cannot be written by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3568
* Gating PR auth checks on actor pushing the code instead of author by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3567
* Seed groups and signature algorithms from the system crypto policy by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3504
* Extend FIPS 3.x EOS to February 2030 by @samuel40791765 in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3539
* fix: Update Ruby (master) integration patch by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3590
* fix(acvp): place the IUT public key correctly in KAS-ECC fixedInfo by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3597
* Support `pkcs12 -export` and `req -batch` in the OpenSSL CLI by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3575
* feat(duvet): RFC 8032 (EdDSA) requirement coverage + annotation-regression CI by @dougch in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3477
* fix: Add patch for failing gRPC master branch by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3591
* Reject unoffered cipher suite in TLS 1.3 client by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3537
* fix(ssl): Check buffer-view bounds before pointer arithmetic by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3566
* fix(x509): Verify CSR proof-of-possession on -req by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3592
* Remove nameRelativeToCRLIssuer CRL distribution point support by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3598
* Use the dummy key when a PKCS#7 content encryption key is the wrong length by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3585
* Resize md_data when an HMAC EVP_MD_CTX changes digest by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3586
* Support RSA encryption/decryption and additional ciphers in the OpenSSL CLI by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3605
* fix(ml_kem): Gate ML-KEM x86-64 on BMI2 in addition to AVX2 by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3596
* fix(ci): restrict calls for autofix by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3599
* Recognise known safe DH groups/primes and short-circuit Diffie-Hellman test by @torben-hansen in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3337
* Harden previous-finished* length in v1/v2 transfer by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3595
* Prepare v5.11.0 by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3610


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v5.10.0...v5.11.0

## What's Changed
* ci: fix openssh-master integration by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3561
* Skip AEAD ConcurrentStability under Intel SDE; add deterministic context-immutability test by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3562
* Zeroize ChaCha20-Poly1305 key material by @nhatnghiho in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3552
* Record job settings for failed integrations by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3569
* Restricting CI permissions so fork-PR code doesn't run CI with ECR push and shared S3 write permissions by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3546
* Fix BIO socket error handling by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3459
* Reject [UNIVERSAL 0] elements with content as end-of-contents by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3560
* Add OpenSSL-compatible rehash -compat support by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3563
* Harden a number of code-paths to avoid e.g. hangs and invalid input by @torben-hansen in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3543
* Guard against NULL attribute type names in X509_NAME_print_ex by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3574
* Fail openssl ca when the issued certificate cannot be written by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3568
* Gating PR auth checks on actor pushing the code instead of author by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3567
* Seed groups and signature algorithms from the system crypto policy by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3504
* Extend FIPS 3.x EOS to February 2030 by @samuel40791765 in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3539
* fix: Update Ruby (master) integration patch by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3590
* fix(acvp): place the IUT public key correctly in KAS-ECC fixedInfo by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3597
* Support `pkcs12 -export` and `req -batch` in the OpenSSL CLI by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3575
* feat(duvet): RFC 8032 (EdDSA) requirement coverage + annotation-regression CI by @dougch in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3477
* fix: Add patch for failing gRPC master branch by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3591
* Reject unoffered cipher suite in TLS 1.3 client by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3537
* fix(ssl): Check buffer-view bounds before pointer arithmetic by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3566
* fix(x509): Verify CSR proof-of-possession on -req by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3592
* Remove nameRelativeToCRLIssuer CRL distribution point support by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3598
* Use the dummy key when a PKCS#7 content encryption key is the wrong length by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3585
* Resize md_data when an HMAC EVP_MD_CTX changes digest by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3586
* Support RSA encryption/decryption and additional ciphers in the OpenSSL CLI by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3605
* fix(ml_kem): Gate ML-KEM x86-64 on BMI2 in addition to AVX2 by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3596
* fix(ci): restrict calls for autofix by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3599
* Recognise known safe DH groups/primes and short-circuit Diffie-Hellman test by @torben-hansen in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3337
* Harden previous-finished* length in v1/v2 transfer by @spwalgren in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3595
* Prepare v5.11.0 by @skmcgrail in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3610


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v5.10.0...v5.11.0

## What's Changed
* Restore ADX/AVX2 code paths under OPENSSL_SMALL via new MY_ASSEMBLER_IS_TOO_OLD_FOR_ADX_AVX2 flag by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3368
* Include <openssl/cipher.h> from <openssl/hmac.h> for OpenSSL compat by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3371
* ci: harden security-review.yml against script injection by @nebeid in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3365
* Fix flaky s_client cipher tests by using better ciphers by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3373
* chore: simplify the api docs workflow by @dougch in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3186
* Add tests for RSASSA-PSS with SHA-3 digest and MGF1 by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3377
* Link header documentation from README by @WillChilds-Klein in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3378
* Rename autofix reasoning role to AwsLcGitHubActionsBedrockRole by @tianyiy-tim in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3376
* ci: pin openssh required job by @dougch in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3387
* delocate: Drop redundant `-dI` flag by @hanno-becker in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3384
* Add Neoverse-V3 (Graviton5) detection and dispatch by @nebeid in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3374
* Bump ring from 0.17.8 to 0.17.14 in /tests/ci/lambda by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3375
* Fix docker image dependencies and update octocrab initialization by @prasden in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3388
* Update FIPS.md by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3382
* Bump urllib3 from 2.6.3 to 2.7.0 in /tests/ci by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3372
* Add MinGW shared-library Windows CI coverage by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3398
* Update concurrency in `security-review` by @nhatnghiho in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3403
* Enable linker garbage collection for non-FIPS static builds by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3397
* Prepare 5.5.0 by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3401

## New Contributors
* @tianyiy-tim made their first contribution in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3376

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v5.4.0...v5.5.0
